resolution: Reverted the operator timeout_ms to the contract maximum 600000. The installed Refine 0.3.1 operator schema enforces 1..=600000, so no single Gate can host the unchanged W8+W9 JPEG definition plus the now-prior W10 suite (~658 s measured work).
consequence: G3 is executed as two finite Gates: the unchanged JPEG definition and the W10 prior-slice suite. See gate-split.json. No check was removed, weakened, reordered away, skipped or auto-retried.
scope: Caller-approved finite W11 Gate scope; not product/Runtime/release/acceptance authority.
